text.title: MLP Planning Examples
text.summary: Worked end-to-end example showing the methodology applied on a representative case.

example.title: MLP plan lifts Day-30 retention from 22% to 38%
example.note: Illustrates four-layer-audit + delight-only-when-base-ge-3 + emotion-evidence-required + retention-curve-as-gate + delight-sprint-bounded.

example.title: Delight on broken base; unbounded polish sprint
Note-taking app — layer-by-layer upgrade
example.note: MVP: create, edit, delete notes with basic formatting. Functional but bland — NPS 30, Day-30 retention weak.

MLP additions by layer. Reliable: auto-save with visual confirmation. Usable: keyboard shortcuts and quick capture. Delightful: smooth animations, satisfying micro-sounds, a Zen mode for focused writing, considered empty states.
Outcome: retention up 40%, NPS 30 -> 55. Note that the Reliable and Usable work preceded the Delightful work, per delight-only-when-base-ge-3.

example.title: Invoicing tool — delight at the success moment
example.note: MVP: create invoices and send them to clients. Functional but clunky.

MLP additions by layer. Reliable: payment confirmation notifications. Usable: templates from past invoices, client auto-fill. Delightful: celebration on payment received, a 'you have earned $X this month' dashboard.
Outcome: users create twice as many invoices, NPS 60. The delight sits on the success moment — the highest-visibility point on the critical path, per polish-priority-formula.
